entry.title: New: dsh-niulai-sound
entry.summary: Approval sound effects from the movie NiuLai: plays 「妈妈」 when user confirmation is requested, interrupts it and plays 「牛来！」 the moment the user approves; native Windows playback, zero external dependencies. Exact install spec: github:isheng-eqi/dsh-niulai-sound. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
